summary: Build a FastAPI modular monolith that crawls arxiv and GitHub on a schedule, normalizes data into a unified database, exposes a REST API for the React frontend, and generates daily/weekly Markdown reports. The full architecture is in docs/architecture.md and the API contract is in docs/api-contract.md.

tech_stack.database: SQLite (default, via aiosqlite) or PostgreSQL (via asyncpg)

project_structure.entry_point: backend/app/main.py — FastAPI app factory with lifespan (start scheduler, create FTS tables on SQLite)
project_structure.config: backend/app/config.py — Pydantic BaseSettings, reads from .env + env vars. See config_vars below.
project_structure.models: backend/app/models/ — one file per entity (paper.py, author.py, category.py, repo.py, tag.py, crawl_log.py, report.py). All extend declarative Base with UUID PKs.
project_structure.schemas: backend/app/schemas/ — Pydantic request/response models, one file per resource + common.py (PaginatedResponse, ErrorResponse)
project_structure.routers: backend/app/routers/ — FastAPI APIRouter per resource. Thin: validate -> call service -> return.
project_structure.services: backend/app/services/ — Business logic. paper_service.py, repo_service.py, tag_service.py, report_service.py, crawl_service.py.
project_structure.crawlers: backend/app/crawlers/ — Plugin system. base.py (BaseCrawler ABC), registry.py (CrawlerRegistry), arxiv.py, github.py.
project_structure.engine: backend/app/engine/ — scheduler.py (APScheduler setup + job registration), report_generator.py (query -> Jinja2 -> file), templates/ (daily.md.j2, weekly.md.j2).

paper.columns: id (UUID PK), title (String 1024, NOT NULL), title_normalized (String 1024, NOT NULL, lowercased + whitespace-collapsed — used for cross-source dedup), abstract (Text, nullable), url (String 2048, NOT NULL), pdf_url (String 2048, nullable), code_url (String 2048, nullable), source (String 32, NOT NULL), source_id (String 128, NOT NULL), venue (String 256, nullable), published_date (Date, nullable), crawled_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow), updated_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow, onupdate utcnow), merged_into_id (UUID, nullable, FK self)
paper.relationships: authors (M2M via paper_author), categories (M2M via paper_category), tags (M2M via paper_tag), merged_into (self FK)
paper.fts: For SQLite: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE paper_fts USING fts5(title, abstract, content='paper', content_rowid='id') with triggers on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. For PostgreSQL: ALTER TABLE paper ADD COLUMN search_vector tsvector; CREATE INDEX ON paper USING GIN(search_vector). The service layer abstracts which backend to use.

author.columns: id (UUID PK), name (String 256, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), affiliation (Text, nullable)

paper_author.columns: paper_id (FK paper.id CASCADE), author_id (FK author.id CASCADE), author_order (Integer, default 0)

category.columns: id (UUID PK), name (String 128, NOT NULL), source (String 32, NOT NULL)

paper_category.columns: paper_id (FK paper.id CASCADE), category_id (FK category.id CASCADE)

github_repo.columns: id (UUID PK), full_name (String 256, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), description (Text, nullable), url (String 2048, NOT NULL), stars (Integer, default 0), forks (Integer, default 0), language (String 64, nullable), topics (JSON, nullable — list of strings), pushed_at (DateTime UTC, nullable), crawled_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow), last_crawled_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow)

user_tag.columns: id (UUID PK), name (String 64, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), color (String 7, NOT NULL — hex from fixed 16-color palette), created_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow)

paper_tag.columns: paper_id (FK paper.id CASCADE), tag_id (FK user_tag.id CASCADE)

repo_tag.columns: repo_id (FK github_repo.id CASCADE), tag_id (FK user_tag.id CASCADE)

crawl_log.columns: id (UUID PK), source (String 32, NOT NULL), started_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL), finished_at (DateTime UTC, nullable), items_found (Integer, default 0), items_new (Integer, default 0), items_updated (Integer, default 0), status (String 16, NOT NULL, default 'running'), error_message (Text, nullable)

report.columns: id (UUID PK), type (String 16, NOT NULL — 'daily' or 'weekly'), date_range_start (Date, NOT NULL), date_range_end (Date, NOT NULL), file_path (String 2048, NOT NULL), paper_count (Integer, default 0), repo_count (Integer, default 0), delivery_status (String 16, default 'pending' — 'pending', 'delivered', 'failed'), generated_at (DateTime UTC, NOT NULL, default utcnow)

dedup_merge_strategy.step1: On crawl, check (source, source_id) uniqueness. If exists, UPDATE the record (upsert).
dedup_merge_strategy.step2: After upsert, compute difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio on title_normalized against papers from OTHER sources.
dedup_merge_strategy.step3: If ratio >= 0.85, set the newer record's merged_into_id to point to the older (canonical) record. The canonical record is the one with merged_into_id IS NULL.
dedup_merge_strategy.step4: When serving GET /papers/{id}, include versions: all papers whose merged_into_id = this id.

config_vars.DATABASE_URL: sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/app.db (default) — switch to postgresql+asyncpg://... for production
config_vars.GITHUB_TOKEN: '' — GitHub personal access token. Without it, rate limit is 60 req/h; with it, 5000 req/h.

crawler_plugin_system.base_class: BaseCrawler(ABC) with attributes: source: str, delay_seconds: float. Abstract methods: async fetch(params) -> list[dict], normalize(raw) -> dict, async run(db: AsyncSession) -> CrawlLog
crawler_plugin_system.registry: CrawlerRegistry: class-level dict mapping source strings to crawler classes. Methods: register(cls), get(source), list_all(). Registration happens at import time in crawlers/__init__.py.
crawler_plugin_system.arxiv_crawler: Queries arxiv API (export.arxiv.org/api/query) for cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.MM, cs.CL. Parses ATOM XML. 3s delay. source='arxiv', source_id=arxiv ID.
crawler_plugin_system.github_crawler: Queries GitHub Search API and Trending page. Topics: computer-vision, deep-learning, object-detection, image-segmentation, generative-models, nerf, 3d-vision, multimodal, video-understanding. Handles 429 via exponential backoff with jitter (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 60s). source='github'. On existing repo: update stars, forks, pushed_at, last_crawled_at.
crawler_plugin_system.error_isolation: Each crawler.run() is wrapped in try/except in scheduler.py. A failure in one crawler logs to CrawlLog with status='failed' and does NOT affect other crawlers or the scheduler.
crawler_plugin_system.adding_new_source: 1) Create new file in crawlers/ extending BaseCrawler. 2) Register in __init__.py. 3) Add scheduler job. 4) No core code changes needed.

report_engine.pipeline: Scheduler triggers -> report_generator.generate(type) -> queries DB for date range -> groups papers by category, sorts by relevance (keyword match heuristic) -> selects trending repos (highest star gain since last report) -> renders Jinja2 template -> writes Markdown to reports/ directory -> persists Report record with delivery_status='delivered'
report_engine.daily_report: Date range: today 00:00 to 23:59. Sections: top 20 new papers grouped by category, new trending repos, category breakdown counts.
report_engine.weekly_report: Date range: last Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59. Sections: top 30 papers, rising repos (biggest star gain), category stats with week-over-week delta, new repos this week.
report_engine.templates: Jinja2 .md.j2 files in backend/app/engine/templates/. Variables: papers, repos, stats, date_range, generated_at.
report_engine.filesystem: Reports saved to {REPORT_OUTPUT_DIR}/{type}-{date_range_end}.md. Appended, never overwritten.

scheduler_jobs.name: crawl_arxiv
scheduler_jobs.func: run ArxivCrawler wrapped in try/except -> log to CrawlLog

scheduler_jobs.name: crawl_github
scheduler_jobs.func: run GitHubCrawler wrapped in try/except -> log to CrawlLog

papers: GET /api/v1/papers — list with filters (source, category, date_from, date_to, q, tag_id, venue), sort (published_date/-published_date/crawled_at/title), pagination
GET /api/v1/papers/{id} — full detail with authors, categories, tags, versions
repos: GET /api/v1/repos — list with filters (language, topic, stars_min, stars_max, pushed_after, pushed_before, tag_id, q), sort (stars/-stars/forks/pushed_at/crawled_at), pagination
tags: GET /api/v1/tags — list all (not paginated, small dataset). Each includes paper_count and repo_count.
POST /api/v1/tags — create (body: {name: str, color: str — must be in 16-color palette})
PUT /api/v1/tags/{id} — update name/color (body: {name?: str, color?: str})
DELETE /api/v1/tags/{id} — delete, cascades removal from paper_tag and repo_tag
reports: GET /api/v1/reports — list with type filter, sort, pagination
GET /api/v1/reports/{id} — metadata + raw Markdown content (read from disk)
POST /api/v1/reports/{id}/retry — regenerate this report for its original date range
crawls: GET /api/v1/crawls/logs — paginated log history, filterable by source and status
GET /api/v1/crawls/status — scheduler status: registered jobs with enabled, last_run, next_run, last_status
POST /api/v1/crawls/trigger/{source} — manually trigger a crawl (async, returns 202 immediately)
categories: GET /api/v1/categories — list all (optionally filtered by source). Includes paper_count per category.
authors: GET /api/v1/authors — list with search (q), pagination. Each includes paper_count.
system: GET /api/v1/health — health check (DB connectivity, scheduler status, version)
GET /api/v1/stats — dashboard stats (total papers/repos/tags, by-source breakdown, new today/week, crawl success rate, top categories, top languages)

pagination_convention.response: { items: T[], total: int, page: int, page_size: int, pages: int }

error_format.shape: { error: { code: string, message: string, details?: object } }
error_format.codes: VALIDATION_ERROR (422), RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404), RESOURCE_CONFLICT (409), CRAWLER_BUSY (409), CRAWLER_NOT_FOUND (404), INTERNAL_ERROR (500)

application_lifespan: On startup: create engine, run Alembic migrations (or create_all in dev), create FTS5 virtual table + triggers if SQLite, register crawlers in CrawlerRegistry, start APScheduler with registered jobs.
On shutdown: shutdown APScheduler, dispose SQLAlchemy engine.
testing_requirements: Use pytest-asyncio with a test SQLite database (in-memory or temp file).
conftest.py provides: async test client (httpx.AsyncClient via FastAPI TestClient), test DB session with create_all/drop_all per test.
Test each crawler's normalize() method with sample API responses (mocked HTTP).
Test each router endpoint for correct status codes, response shapes, and filter behavior.
Test dedup merge logic: insert two papers with similar titles, verify merged_into_id is set.
Test report generation: generate a report, verify file exists and contains expected sections.
excluded_from_v1: Conference proceedings crawler (dblp/OpenReview — skip, but Paper model has venue field ready)
Email/Slack/webhook report delivery (model has delivery_status ready)
